BiblicalUsage: Shavsha was the scribe, the royal secretary, in David's court, named beside Zadok and Abimelech the priests. A scribe keeps the record, and the record keeps his name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the scribe's quiet work matters: without him the king's reign is not written down. Shavsha held the pen, and I hold that faithful record-keeping is service to the Lord.
